name: Camp Beech Cliff
description_short: Weekly summer camp on Mount Desert Island, Maine. Traditional camps are for grades K-7, with separate specialty, teen and Friday overnight programs. Rates are lower for Hancock County residents.
refund_policy_summary: Each camper pays a $30 registration fee once per season. It is non-refundable unless the camper stays on the waitlist and never gets a spot. A $50 deposit per week ($25 for approved campership applicants) is due by May 1 and is non-refundable after May 1. The weekly balance is due, and can be refunded, up to two weeks before the camp week starts; after that no refunds are given. There are no discounts if a camper attends only part of a week.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, which ended August 28, 2026. 2027 dates and rates have not been posted yet.

Two weekly rates apply: $495 standard and $300 for Hancock County residents. Residency depends on where the camper goes to school. Session prices use the $495 standard rate. The page lists $670 as the 'true cost' of a week, but no one is charged that.
The rates on this page are for Traditional Camp (grades K-7). Specialty, teen, CIT and Friday Overnight programs may cost something different.
Camp type was recorded as day camp based on page context. The page does not say it is a day camp in so many words. Friday Overnights are a separate program.
